dialog.title: General & precautionary power of attorney
dialog.description: Authorisation of a trusted person in case you are no longer able to act yourself.
step.vollmachtgeber.title: Principal(s)
field.anzahl_vollmachtgeber.label: Number of principals
field.vollmachtgeber.label: Principal
field.gegenseitige_bevollmaechtigung.lab: Should the two principals appoint each other as attorneys?
step.bevollmaechtigte.title: Appointed attorneys
field.anzahl_bevollmaechtigte.label: Number of appointed attorneys
field.bevollmaechtigte.label: Appointed attorney
field.rangverhaeltnis.label: Should the attorneys act in a ranking order?
field.rangverhaeltnis.helpText: With ranking: the second attorney only acts if the first cannot.
step.umfang.title: Scope of the power of attorney
field.umfang_freifeld.label: Scope of the power of attorney
field.umfang_freifeld.placeholder: e.g. comprehensive general and precautionary power, possibly with restrictions
field.spezifische_wuensche.label: Are there specific drafting requests?
field.spezifische_wuensche.placeholder: E.g. principal's company shareholdings; restrictions on the scope of the power
field.schenkungen.label: Are gifts by the attorney permitted?
field.grundbesitz.label: Does the principal own real estate?
field.grundbesitz.helpText: Important for entries in the land register.
field.grundbesitz_details.label: Details of the real estate
field.unternehmensbeteiligung.label: Does the principal hold shareholdings in companies?
field.unternehmen_details.label: Details of the company shareholdings
field.wirksamkeit.label: When should the power of attorney become effective?
field.wirksamkeit.helpText: Recommended: immediately. Conditional powers are difficult to use in practice.
step.patientenverfuegung.title: Living will
field.patientenverfuegung.label: Is a living will also desired?
field.patientenverfuegung.helpText: Living will: written statement of medical wishes in case of incapacity to decide.
field.pv_lebensverlaengernd.label: Life-prolonging measures?
field.pv_lebensverlaengernd.option.Ableh: Refuse if there is no prospect of improvement
field.pv_lebensverlaengernd.option.Wünsc: Decision in each case by the appointed attorney
field.pv_kuenstliche_ernaehrung.label: Artificial nutrition?
field.pv_kuenstliche_ernaehrung.option.B: When there is a prospect of improvement
field.pv_schmerzmittel.label: Pain and sedative medication?
field.pv_schmerzmittel.option.Höchste Pr: Highest priority, even if it shortens life
field.pv_anmerkungen.label: Personal wishes / remarks
field.organspende.label: Willingness to donate organs?
step.betreuung_register.title: Registration
field.betreuungsverfuegung_person.label: Preferred custodian
field.betreuung_unerwuenscht.label: Persons who should not become custodians
field.zentrales_register.label: Registration in the Central Register of Precautionary Powers desired?
field.zentrales_register.helpText: Courts, doctors etc. can check for existing powers of attorney – this helps avoid statutory guardianship.
field.bemerkungen.label: Remarks (optional)
field.dokumente.label: Upload documents (optional)
field.dokumente.helpText: E.g. existing living will, copies of identification, land register extract.
